prompt: Find the top 3 sent campaigns by open rate from the last 30 days. You will need to (1) list recent campaigns and (2) pull campaign reports for each. Put the answer inside `final_answer` as a JSON array of exactly 3 objects, each with fields: name, open_rate. Order by open_rate descending.

claims.description: each item has name and open_rate

notes: Hits campaign-values-reports — Klaviyo throttles at 1/s burst, 2/min sustained. Pacing adds +8s.
